description: Page replacement on a reference string: FIFO, LRU, OPT (Belady) and CLOCK (second chance), or ALL to compare. Gives the faults counted BOTH ways in use — every fault including the cold start (Silberschatz) and only after the frames are full (Stallings) — so the number matches the course. With one algorithm and up to 60 references it also gives the frame table step by step (victim, use bits and hand for CLOCK). Returns a link that replays it.

references.description: Page numbers separated by spaces or commas, e.g. "7 0 1 2 0 3 0 4 2 3 0 3 2 1 2 0 1 7 0 1"

name: os_page_replace
